nodes.name: PATCH Sales Engine Pooled Close Rate

parameters.content:
## WF CEO Actuals Refresh (rewritten 2026-07-10, G-B + Sales Engine extension; + 2026-07-13 pooled close-rate branch)

Weekly (Mon 07:00) + manual. Three branches; Branch 3 is cumulative/all-time and does NOT depend on the last-completed-week data the other two use:

**Branch 1 -- CEO Command Center (Priority Tracker):**
- **New Leads** (week) = count of Opportunities with Created At in the last completed Mon-Sun week.
- **Alignment Calls** (week) = count of Raw Appointments in that week whose Calender Title contains "alignment".
- **Closes per Week** (week) = period rolled forward, Actual left BLANK on purpose -- shell, gated on the still-unverified paid roster.
- **Lead Generation per Month** (month) = GA4 sitewide activeUsers, month-to-date, property 507732502. Expected near-zero -- real finding, not a bug.

**Branch 2 -- Sales Engine weekly row (added 2026-07-10, replaces "SAMPLE . Weekly Rollup -> Sales Engine"):**
Writes New Leads, Alignment Calls Booked/Conducted, and the by-rep breakdown (John/Heather/Mitchell/Katie) onto the current week's Sales Engine row via an explicit GET-then-decide-then-PATCH/POST (GET Sales Engine Week -> Decide Create or Update -> Write Sales Engine Week) -- NOT n8n's native "upsert" operation, which was tried first and produced 2 duplicate rows for the same Week in one run (its date-field match didn't reliably find its own freshly-written row; both duplicates were deleted 2026-07-10). The retired workflow had 3 stacked bugs: it measured the week AHEAD instead of the week just ended (near-zero always), it upserted matched on Airtable's own record id which the code never output (could never match), and it bucketed closes off Win Basis values ("catalyst_paid" etc.) that do not exist on the live field. This branch fixes the first two (date window + reliable match-or-create). It deliberately leaves ALL close-related fields untouched (Catalyst/Core/Circle/Capital Engine/Nexus Total Closed, and therefore the close-rate formulas that read them) -- those need a live paid+tier signal that doesn't exist yet (same gap as the Task 2 paid-roster fix). Do not invent a bucketing rule to fill them; wait for the real signal.

**Branch 3 -- Sales Engine pooled Overall Close Rate (added 2026-07-13, Task 5 CORRECTION):**
Computes the TRUE overall close rate = cumulative Paid Members (Membership Conversion, live row) / cumulative alignment-calls-conducted-or-beyond (Opportunities where Unified Stage is Alignment Call Conducted/Pulse Check Booked/Pulse Check Conducted/Closed Won/Closed Lost -- live snapshot 2026-07-13 = 21; includes one known test row "Test Arham" EXAMPLE_AIRTABLE_ID_1C304922E8 still not deleted per PRODUCTION_GROUND_TRUTH SS B15). Writes the decimal into Sales Engine's `Overall Close Rate (Pooled)` field (fld0YUjiLS4qdBba4) on ONE hardcoded record id (EXAMPLE_AIRTABLE_ID_47E2A97675, the most-recent existing Sales Engine row as of 2026-07-13) -- deliberately NOT the rolling "current week" row from Branch 2, because a new row is created every week and writing there would eventually put non-blank values on multiple rows, breaking the CEO tile's Average-summary (which must resolve to exactly one pooled value). If Misa wants a different anchor row, change the record id in the "PATCH Sales Engine Pooled Close Rate" node's URL -- nothing else needs to change. Does NOT touch the orphaned `Alignment Calls Conducted` field on Membership Conversion (fldDQASQtiITUUl7W, dead ADD-ON leftover -- Misa to delete in UI) and does NOT re-patch Paid Members/Membership Revenue/Proximity Members anywhere (see Branch 1 note below).

**Membership rows (Paid Members / Membership Revenue / Proximity Members) are still deliberately NOT touched by this workflow.** They were hand-corrected in Task 1/2 (PRODUCTION_GROUND_TRUTH SS B33) after the dead `(by Aug 31)` keys were found silently failing to patch them -- Paid Members is now 2 (not 14), Membership Revenue is blanked pending a real payment feed. Re-adding automated patching here would risk silently overwriting those hand-fixed numbers if the (currently inactive) Membership Conversion automations ever get reactivated. Branch 3 above reads Paid Members live (read-only) for its own calculation without writing it back anywhere.

**Action for Misa:** delete "SAMPLE . Weekly Rollup -> Sales Engine" from n8n once Branch 2 is verified live -- this workflow now covers everything it was supposed to do, correctly. "GHL Calendar -> Sales Engine" is a DIFFERENT, misleadingly-named workflow (it actually feeds Raw Appointments via webhook, not Sales Engine) -- leave that one alone, it's unrelated and still useful. Also: rebind the CEO "Overall Close Rate" tile to Sales Engine's `Overall Close Rate (Pooled)` field (source stays Sales Engine, summary stays Average) -- separate UI step, not doable via API.

**Before running:** re-select the Airtable credential (n8n SAMPLE OS Integration, id ED2bB9oQnzN5KH4n) and the Google Analytics credential (id E0J7LSjtunaQFQFU) if either imports as a placeholder.
